==About==

A {{i|Roasted Horse Steak}} is obtained when crafting {{i|Roasted Meat}} using a {{i|Raw Horse Steak}} over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}.
